items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Sy would make arrangements. ... we played on the radio. ... Sy would make arrangements and other people would make arrangements. And we rehearsed and then we'd do this big show every week

ctx.x: Well, we practiced mostly, most of the time. Sy would make arrangements.

Yes. He was the main arranger and we played on the radio. We had one show once a week where soldiers would come from all different camps. Sy would make arrangements and other people would make arrangements. And we rehearsed and then we'd do this big show every week That was one thing we did. Another thing we did was to play will head That's to play for the soldiers as they are getting on the boat to go to Europe. And we'd sometimes go out there five o'clock in the morning, freezing cold and stay there until two…
